description: LedgerPilot guard policies — READABLE EVIDENCE COPY. Kernel-enforced rules live at .swytchcode/integrations/policies.json (swy policy list / swy policy validate). Conditions resolve real request args (docs.swytchcode.com/policies/policy-rules) and were verified firing with swy exec --dry-run (exit 7 approval / exit 6 blocked) + swy audit policy.

rules.description: Sending a PayPal invoice (invoices.invoicing.send.create) requires human approval: kernel REQUIRES_APPROVAL behind the UI Approve button.
rules.prompt: LedgerPilot wants to send a PayPal payment chase. Approve?

rules.description: Gmail intake is read-only: 15 write tools (send/drafts/trash/modify/labels) are POLICY_BLOCKED by the kernel; only messages.list/get are enabled in tooling.json.
rules.verified: swy policy list → any (5 sub-conditions); blocked post-auth (auth is checked first)

rules.description: Any PayPal call explicitly tagged env=live is blocked — the demo never touches live money.
rules.verified: swy exec --dry-run env=live → exit 6 policy_denied + swy audit policy entry

rules.description: Allowlist: money movement outside the approval-gated invoice path (payments/orders/payouts) is blocked.
rules.verified: tooling.json allowlist refuses them first (not_configured); policy is defence in depth
